# Myles Yeo Tan - Crypto Trader, Financial Planner & Christian Entrepreneur

> Christian entrepreneur, cryptocurrency trader, financial planner, and public speaker specializing in faith-based financial wisdom and market analysis

Learn about Myles' journey from crypto trading to becoming a certified financial planner and sought-after public speaker. Includes credentials, certifications, and professional background.

## Services

### Crypto, Stocks & Commodities Trading Analysis
https://mylesyeotan.com/services#crypto

Market cycle analysis, technical analysis, risk management, and trade psychology coaching grounded in disciplined decision-making.

### Financial Planning and Literacy
https://mylesyeotan.com/services#financial

Values-aligned financial planning, budgeting, cash-flow optimization, and goal-based financial roadmapping for individuals and families.

### Christian Entrepreneurship Coaching
https://mylesyeotan.com/services#coaching

Faith-based business strategy, mentorship for founders and leaders, and guidance on building businesses that honor God.

### Speaking Engagements
https://mylesyeotan.com/services#speaking

Keynotes, seminars, and panel talks on faith, finance, leadership, and purpose-driven themes tailored to your audience.
